name: ebay_search
description: eBay search results (sorted newest, _sop=12), s-card layout. Returns title/price/url arrays for item listings in the results river. Every field anchors to a per-card container eBay renders on each listing, so a card missing its price yields null in that slot instead of shifting the whole price column. Titles read the styled-text span as a direct child of .s-card__title (the container also holds a screen-reader-only 'Opens in a new window or tab'), and urls take the header anchor as a direct child so the card's image link is not collected. KNOWN CHANGE vs the su-card layout: the old [href*='/itm/'] filter is gone because applying it to one field alone re-introduces row shrinkage, so a non-item card in the river (eBay's 'Shop on eBay' dummy or a /sch/ related-search suggestion) is now emitted as a row — filter on the url if that matters. Neither shape occurred in 120 live cards (2026-07-26). Per-listing condition/shipping aren't column-alignable here; use LLM extraction for reliable per-row data.
